Ireland boycotts Eurovision over Gaza conflict

Ireland has announced it will not participate in the Eurovision Song Contest, citing the ongoing conflict in Gaza. The decision means Ireland will not send a participant to the competition. This marks the second consecutive year Ireland has opted out of the event.
